question: Which category of vehicles does the European emission standards for passenger cars fall under?
solution:
The correct answer is __Category M.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• European emission standards__ are a set of regulations for controlling air pollution from vehicles.
 
• They specify the maximum permissible emissions for various pollutants including nitrogen oxides, carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons, and particulate matter.
 
• These standards are applied to passenger cars categorized under Category M.
 
• Category M vehicles are motor vehicles used for the carriage of passengers with at least four wheels.
 
• The standards are updated periodically, with stricter limits introduced in later stages such as Euro 6.
 
• Emission regulations aim to reduce environmental impact and improve public health by minimizing air pollution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Category N:**

 
 
• Category N includes motor vehicles used for the carriage of goods.
 
• Examples include light commercial vehicles and heavy-duty trucks.
 
 
 
• **Category L:**
 
 
• Category L includes two- and three-wheeled vehicles and quadricycles.
 
• These include motorcycles, mopeds, and similar vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Category H:**
 
 
• This category pertains to tracked vehicles, such as those used in construction or agriculture.
 
• Examples include bulldozers and tractors.
